title: Austrian Foreign Ministry reports unauthorised access to a supplier-run website, staff contact data viewed
date_note: Access on 12 to 13 November, noticed 13 November; ORF (20 November) says the ministry reported it the previous evening, 19 November.
summary: Austria's Foreign Ministry said, as relayed by ORF, that a website run by an external service provider was accessed without authorisation from 12 to 13 November; it noticed this on 13 November and stopped it immediately. Only names and work contact details of staff were viewed, no citizens' data. The ministry reported it to the Federal Office for Cybersecurity and the data protection authority and said the access coincided with a worldwide Microsoft outage.
plain: Austria's Foreign Ministry says someone gained unauthorised access to a supplier-run website and saw staff names and work contact details, but no citizen data, per its statement.
exec: A government ministry's supplier-run website was accessed without authorisation; the ministry says only staff contact data was viewed.
org: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs

sources.name: ORF.at (20 November 2026, citing the ministry press release)

validation.note: ORF.at and the EFE wire (read on Latinus and ABC Color) each report the ministry's statement: access 12-13 November, noticed 13 November, staff names and work contact details, no citizens' data. The ministry's own release was not read. Follow-up 22 Nov re-read ORF: ministry reported it to the Federal Office for Cybersecurity and the data protection authority, and announced it the evening of 19 November. No release found on bmeia.gv.at (list loads by script).
